verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a features-page heading, 'Digital offer letters & eSignatures', which supports offer letters with built-in e-signature only at a headline level. A separate generic templates mention does not establish offer-letter templates. The API 'offers' endpoints describe job postings, not offer letters. Missing for 10: offer-letter templates with dynamic or merge fields, approval routing or approval chains, detailed documentation of the e-signature flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
